section.p: Manages the full academic lifecycle from Research Methodology prerequisite verification, supervisor approval, proposal & thesis progress logs, sequential Yudisium clearance, to nearest Graduation (Wisuda) assignment.

div.class: card border-0 shadow-sm rounded-4 mb-4 border-info border-top border-4

ol.li: Curriculum Prerequisite (Research Methodology): Only students who have passed a Research Methodology subject in their KHS may register a thesis.
Supervisor Selection & Approval: Students pick a Primary Supervisor (and optional Co-Supervisor). Assigned lecturers approve or reject with feedback.
Proposal Stage: Students log consultation progress until the Primary Supervisor approves the proposal.
Thesis Course Gate: Proceeding to the Thesis Stage requires enrolling in a Thesis subject in an Approved or Locked KRS.
Yudisium Filing & Sequential Approval: Once the thesis is approved and required documents are verified, clearance runs sequentially: Thesis Supervisor → Academic Advisor (PA) → Dean of Faculty.
Nearest Graduation Schedule: Final Dean approval marks the student as Graduated and automatically assigns the nearest open Wisuda batch.
